_purpose: Canonical registry of every pullable store and its Studio collector. This is the single source of truth for reproducing the entire fleet on any environment or Bright Data account. See docs/collector-runbook.md for the step-by-step setup procedure.

_storeFields.storeId: Primary key in the stores table
_storeFields.name: Human-readable store name
_storeFields.method: Site structure type: shopify, magento-graphql, sitemap, or sitemap-bounded
_storeFields.endpoint: JSON API or GraphQL endpoint for HTTP adapters (null for sitemap stores)
_storeFields.studioEndpoint: URL the Studio adapter uses at pull time. For listing-page stores: HTML product listing page. For sitemap stores: the sitemap URL used for product URL discovery.
_storeFields.maxPages: Hard ceiling on pages/URLs fetched per pull (cost bound)
_storeFields.needsBrowser: Whether the site requires a real browser to render (JS-only content)
_storeFields.needsUnlocker: Whether requests route through Bright Data Web Unlocker
_storeFields.indexContributor: Whether this store's prices feed the basket price index

_collectorFields.seedUrl: The URL passed as the first arg to scraper create. For listing-page collectors this is a listing page; for product-page collectors this is a representative product page.
_collectorFields.description: The concise instruction passed to scraper create. Derived from probeFindings but never a dump of them.
_collectorFields.template: listing-page or product-page. Documentation only; Studio infers the type.
_collectorFields.probeFindings: Internal team notes. Structural knowledge from HTTP probing that informed the description. Never sent to Studio.

_expectedFields.note: These are the fields studio.adapter.ts toRows() consumes. A canary passes if every row contains all required fields.

collectors.name: basketwatch-ph-shopgaisano
collectors.description: This is a Shopify grocery store in the Philippines. Extract every product from this collection listing page. For each product return: name (string), price (number in PHP), currency ('PHP'), url (full product page URL starting with https://shopgaisano.com/products/), size or weight if shown (e.g. '5kg', '500g', '1L'), in_stock (boolean, true unless marked 'Sold out'). Extract only products visible on this page; do not follow links to other pages.
collectors.probeFindings: Shopify store. /products.json returns 250 items/page with {title, handle, variants[0].price, tags}. Prices are in PHP with no currency symbol in the JSON. /collections/all renders a paginated product grid. Server-rendered json-ld on individual product pages. 1,406 products in sitemap.

collectors.name: basketwatch-us-kesargrocery
collectors.description: This is a US grocery store product page (Kesar Grocery). The page has no structured data; the product name is in the main heading and the price is displayed near it in USD. Extract: name (string), price (number in USD), currency ('USD'), url (the page URL), category if visible, size or weight if shown (e.g. '4LB', '24oz', '1KG'), in_stock (boolean). Extract from this single page only; do not navigate to other pages.
collectors.probeFindings: Sitemap-based store with NO structured data (no json-ld, no microdata, no OpenGraph product tags). Prices are in raw HTML, extracted via CSS class containing 'price' and regex. 11,987 products in sitemap. Product name is in the h1 heading. Bare-HTML extraction: most likely to break on redesign, strong heal subject.

collectors.probeFindings: Server-rendered bare HTML with no structured data. No sitemap; product URLs discovered by crawling categories from the homepage. Wholesale case pricing: median 14.98x retail. Demoted from index contributor; unit prices suppressed.

collectors.name: basketwatch-ph-landers
collectors.description: This is a Philippine grocery store product page (Landers Superstore). The page is fully client-rendered; prices only appear after JavaScript execution. Extract: name (string), price (number in PHP), currency ('PHP'), url (the page URL), category if shown, size or weight if shown (e.g. '1.5L', '1kg', '500g'), in_stock (boolean). Extract from this single page only; do not navigate to other pages.
collectors.probeFindings: Client-rendered SPA (spa-opaque). 0 rows from HTTP, even through the Web Unlocker -- no price appears in raw HTML at all. No public API found; JS bundles reference private microservices (api.landers.ph, core-ms.landers.ph, Unbxd search). Studio with a real browser is the ONLY access path. 17,032 URLs in sitemap, 10/10 basket categories.
